display_name: Ops demo: the Terminal close up
description: Fenlow's field engineer is setting up remote support for the file server. Read a scanner's report and a console's search in the Terminal, test which findings are real, then see what a timed sign-in token, a shared screen and a keyboard-only device give you over a remote session.
test_objective: Show the Terminal's tables, scanner write-ups and console search, the realism text for checked findings, a timed token, a relay session, the keyboard-only device refusal and the whole-word unplug.
